title: poa rothii
intro: Poa rothii, commonly known as Roth's meadow grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Poa rothii include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Poa rothii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that may contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects.
